name: Mintlify Index MCP server
summary: Retired by the vendor. One public MCP endpoint Mintlify ran for every caller, reading across the documentation it hosted and the open web; measured keyless 2026-10-07, one tool, context. On 2026-10-17 at 12:08Z the same keyless initialize, tools/list and tools/call each answered 200 carrying one sentence instead of a result: "Mintlify Index has been discontinued and this MCP server no longer returns results." The vendor's changelog dates the discontinuation October 16, 2026. The 2026-10-07 records stand as dated history; nothing in this entry is current except the retirement.
